description: Canonical record schema for real workflow eval cases extracted from workspace artifacts.

field_notes.id: Stable kebab-case identifier. Prefix with suite slug when possible.
field_notes.created: ISO-8601 timestamp for when the case record was created.
field_notes.suite: Target workflow suite that owns the case.
field_notes.mode: capability or regression; must match suite intent.
field_notes.source_family: High-level family of the artifact the case was mined from.
field_notes.source_path: Workspace-relative path to the original artifact.
field_notes.title: Short human-readable label.
field_notes.description: One-sentence description of what the case verifies.
field_notes.test_type: Executable evaluation primitive currently supported by the runner.
field_notes.test_payload: Payload consumed by the runner; for file_contains use path + contains, for trace_review use trace_fixture + assertions.
field_notes.expected_outcome: Expected evaluation result for the case.
field_notes.confidence: Curator confidence that the case is representative and stable.
field_notes.evidence: Optional list of concrete supporting observations from the source artifact.
field_notes.contradiction: Optional known counter-signal; use null if none.
field_notes.next_test: Optional next refinement or follow-up check for weak cases.
field_notes.components_covered: List of ablation-relevant controls exercised by the case.
field_notes.notes: Optional curator notes, including whether the case was backfilled from production-like history.
